original_document.title: WE Balance Services | Credit Transfer, Borrowing & Mobile Balance Tools in Egypt - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: Services available: - Salefny Extra: Now you can borrow up to 48 EGP with lowest service fees. - Call Me: You can send an SMS to another number asking him to call you. To subscribe, dial *515*other party's number#. - Balance Transfer: Now, you can transfer from 30Pts to 100 EGP at a time. To subscribe, dial *551*number*Amount#. - Call Completion Services: Running out of balance! No worries. Now with WE you can complete your call normally. - Auto Call Collect: Now you can create a list of WE numbers and you will pay the calls.
